The more reliable recollection is that 3004.90.92 has suffixes such as 05 (Other: Antineoplastic), 10, 15, 20, 25, and so on, and that 3004.90.9250 might be "Other," but I am not sure.

I could not verify the exact statistical suffix, so I am choosing 3004.90.9290 as the general "Other" line. This is a best estimate.
